claims_and_limits: Restic 0.19.1 is listed as the latest release on October 27, 2026 and was published July 5; the restore workflow predates this maintenance release.
Default check verifies repository structure; --read-data additionally reads stored pack data, which may require substantial transfer.
Restore overwrites target files by default; a fresh test target is used in the proposed exercise.
The drill is an editorial procedure, not a reported product benchmark or universal recovery guarantee.

visual.central_question: Can a team restore a chosen backup and use the result within its recovery target?
visual.shared_motif: A slate-blue repository yields files into an isolated folder, then inspection makes the result actionable.
visual.infographic_argument: Choose a snapshot, restore into an empty test space, verify documents, hashes, permissions and application usability.
visual.status: Conceptual procedure; no dates, measured outcomes or product screen are depicted. Cover and native infographic inspected.
